basis: Original v1.2 sections 9.3, WASM-13, BIZ07 and performance profiles

coordination.engineering: Integrator may implement code and available automated fixtures independently
coordination.deviceAndParticipantAssignment: User or explicitly designated coordinator; no person is invented or scheduled by this file

resources.acceptanceScope: Actual Node WASM only, not browser or device substitution
resources.recoveryCondition: Recheck exact runtime fingerprint after any environment replacement

resources.category: desktop Chrome with real served non-isolated and strict-CSP pages
resources.reason: Current exec Chromium launch reports socket EPERM; cloud CDP browser is a different host and cannot reach exec localhost. No website deployment is authorized.
resources.recoveryCondition: Provide an authorized reachable test origin/collector on an actual Chrome host without bypassing restrictions.

resources.reason: No verified target instance, browser version or collector is assigned.
resources.recoveryCondition: Assign a real target machine/browser fingerprint and supported collector.

resources.reason: No verified real Safari host/version/collector is assigned. Playwright WebKit is not a substitute.
resources.recoveryCondition: Assign a supported real macOS Safari host and collector.

resources.category: actual Android device with target WebView
resources.reason: Exact device model, OS/WebView, access, recording and tester are not assigned. Desktop/mobile emulation cannot satisfy this item.
resources.recoveryCondition: Record device/OS/WebView fingerprint, approved access, tester and availability.

resources.category: actual iPhone or iPad with Safari
resources.reason: Exact device model, iOS/Safari, touch/recording access and tester are not assigned. WebKit simulation cannot satisfy this item.
resources.recoveryCondition: Record actual device/iOS/Safari fingerprint, approved access, tester and availability.

resources.category: three people not involved in implementation
resources.reason: Participants, coordinator and observation time are not assigned. An agent cannot substitute for a participant.
resources.recoveryCondition: Arrange three first-time participants, use the frozen instructions and preserve actual observations; at least two complete the first order unaided within 90 seconds.

gateEffect: Resource roles and recovery conditions can support M0 planning; unavailable resources remain in required denominators. This file does not complete G0/G1/G5/G7/G8.
